'''Shon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was one of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Shalath]]'s five [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentices]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Shon and the others were sent to use Sith runes in a ritual to bind a [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]], but they were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas's]] wildlife before they could complete the ritual. She carried the [[Rune of Strength]].<ref name="Shadow Spawn" />
